name: Apelex
summary:
Apelex is a fast-paced multiplayer game where you run, fight, and play with friends using Gorilla Tag-style movement. Customize your style, level up, and dive into chaotic game modes like PvP, boxing, infection, and waves.
Run and jump through skill-based maps, challenge your friends, or just chill and explore. Whether you're in it to compete or just mess around, Apelex is all about fun, freedom, and nonstop action.
